description: This file contains JUnit 5 test cases for the BinaryDataHandler class within the OpenMRS project, specifically testing supported views, view support checks, and the saveObs method's MIME type handling.

classes.name: BinaryDataHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the BinaryDataHandler's functionality, including supported views, support checks, and saving observations.

methods.name: shouldReturnSupportedViews
methods.description: Tests that the handler returns the correct list of supported views, specifically checking for RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: shouldSupportRawView
methods.description: Verifies that the handler reports support for the RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: shouldNotSupportOtherViews
methods.description: Ensures that the handler correctly reports not supporting various other view types.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldRetrieveCorrectMimetype
methods.description: Tests that the saveObs method correctly sets the MIME type for complex data in observations.
